items.name: METKA (Metlen)

note.de: Zeichnung bis 20.11., 16 Uhr, zu 10,00–11,50 Euro; laut Medien schon am 19.11. überzeichnet mit Geboten über 300 Mio. Euro (Kapitalerhöhung bis 250 Mio.); Preis am 20.11., erster Handelstag 26.11.
note.bg: Записване до 20.11., 16 ч., по 10,00–11,50 евро; според медиите още на 19.11. е презаписано с поръчки над 300 млн. евро (увеличение на капитала до 250 млн.); цена на 20.11., първи ден на търговия 26.11.
note.en: Subscription until 4pm on 20 Nov at EUR 10.00–11.50; media say it was already oversubscribed on 19 Nov with bids above EUR 300m (capital increase of up to EUR 250m); pricing on 20 Nov, first trading day 26 Nov.
note.es: Suscripción hasta las 16:00 del 20/11 a 10,00–11,50 euros; según la prensa, ya estaba sobresuscrita el 19/11 con ofertas de más de 300 millones (ampliación de capital de hasta 250 millones); precio el 20/11, cotiza desde el 26/11.
note.tr: Talep toplama 20.11 saat 16.00'ya kadar, 10,00–11,50 euro; basına göre 19.11'de 300 milyon euroyu aşan tekliflerle şimdiden aşırı talep gördü (sermaye artırımı en fazla 250 milyon); fiyat 20.11'de, ilk işlem günü 26.11.

items.name: Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL)

note.de: Coal India verkauft 10 % der Tochter zu 129–136 Rupien (rund 89,8 Mrd. Rupien); Zeichnung 19.–23.11., am Vormittag des 20.11. erst rund 0,4-fach gezeichnet, Großanleger 1,26-fach; Notierung voraussichtlich 27.11.
note.bg: Coal India продава 10% от дъщерното дружество по 129–136 рупии (около 89,8 млрд. рупии); записване 19–23.11., сутринта на 20.11. едва около 0,4 пъти, институционалните 1,26 пъти; листване се очаква на 27.11.
note.en: Coal India sells 10% of the unit at INR 129–136 (about INR 89.8bn); subscription 19–23 Nov, only about 0.4 times subscribed on the morning of 20 Nov, institutions 1.26 times; listing expected on 27 Nov.
note.es: Coal India vende el 10 % de la filial a 129–136 rupias (unos 89.800 millones); suscripción del 19 al 23/11, la mañana del 20/11 solo cubierta unas 0,4 veces, institucionales 1,26 veces; cotización prevista el 27/11.
note.tr: Coal India iştirakinin %10'unu 129–136 rupiden satıyor (yaklaşık 89,8 milyar rupi); talep 19–23.11, 20.11 sabahı yalnızca yaklaşık 0,4 kat, kurumsallar 1,26 kat; işlem başlangıcı 27.11'de bekleniyor.

note.en: Secondary sale only of 4.17m existing shares (plus 0.63m over-allotment); offer price set on 18 Nov at JPY 1,240, the top of the range, subscription 19–25 Nov.
note.es: Solo venta de 4,17 millones de acciones existentes (más 0,63 millones de sobreasignación); precio fijado el 18/11 en 1.240 JPY, el máximo del rango, suscripción del 19 al 25/11.
note.tr: Yalnızca 4,17 milyon mevcut hissenin satışı (artı 0,63 milyon ek tahsis); fiyat 18.11'de aralığın üst ucu olan 1.240 JPY olarak belirlendi, talep 19–25.11.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 83 USD (Spanne war 70–78 USD); am ersten Handelstag 19.11. Eröffnung bei 111,50 USD, Schlusskurs 97,17 USD – 17,1 % über dem Ausgabepreis; Abschluss des Angebots am 20.11.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 83 USD (диапазонът беше 70–78 USD); в първия ден на търговия, 19.11., отваряне при 111,50 USD, затваряне при 97,17 USD – със 17,1% над цената на предлагането; приключване на 20.11.
note.en: Offer price USD 83 (range was USD 70–78); on the first trading day, 19 Nov, it opened at USD 111.50 and closed at USD 97.17 – 17.1% above the offer price; offering closes on 20 Nov.
note.es: Precio de salida 83 USD (el rango era 70–78 USD); en su primer día, el 19/11, abrió a 111,50 USD y cerró a 97,17 USD, un 17,1 % por encima del precio de salida; cierre de la oferta el 20/11.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 83 USD (aralık 70–78 USD idi); 19.11'deki ilk işlem gününde 111,50 USD'den açıldı, 97,17 USD'den kapandı – halka arz fiyatının %17,1 üzerinde; arzın kapanışı 20.11.
